mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ips.target_pool_id FROM ip_pool_status ips INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = ips.security_type AND dst.category_type = 'company' AND dst.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ip_investment_pool p ON p.id = ips.target_pool_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.status = 'enabled' WHERE ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 AND p.pool_type != 'crmw' ORDER BY ips.target_pool_id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT pool_id FROM ip_pool_auto_rule WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND task_code = #{taskCode} AND rule_type = #{ruleType} AND pool_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pool_id ASC

SELECT ips.security_code ,ips.security_short_name ,ips.security_type ,si.maturity_date FROM ip_pool_status ips INNER JOIN rrs_securityinfo si ON si.wind_code = ips.security_code INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = ips.security_type AND dst.is_deleted = 0 AND dst.category_type IN ('bond', 'stock') WHERE ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 AND ips.security_type != 'crmw' AND si.maturity_date IS NOT NULL AND si.maturity_date != '' AND si.maturity_date < DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{maturityOffsetDays} DAY), '%Y%m%d')

SELECT bond.wind_code AS security_code ,bond.short_name AS security_short_name ,bond.security_type ,bond.abs_flag ,bond.issuer_code ,bond.issuer AS issuer_name ,bond.issuer_code AS trigger_company_code FROM rrs_securityinfo bond INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = bond.security_type AND dst.is_deleted = 0 AND dst.category_type = 'bond' WHERE bond.security_status != 'D' AND (bond.maturity_date IS NULL OR bond.maturity_date > DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m%d'))
AND NOT (COALESCE(bond.abs_flag, 0) = 1 OR bond.security_type = 'abs')
AND bond.security_type NOT IN
#{securityType}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status cps INNER JOIN dict_security_type cdst ON cdst.security_type = cps.security_type AND cdst.is_deleted = 0 AND cdst.category_type = 'company' WHERE cps.security_code = bond.issuer_code AND cps.target_pool_id = #{companyPoolId} AND cps.audit_status = '20' AND cps.is_deleted = 0 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status bps WHERE bps.security_code = bond.wind_code AND bps.target_pool_id = #{targetPoolId} AND bps.audit_status = '20' AND bps.is_deleted = 0 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM rrs_temp_security_code ts WHERE ts.temp_security_code = bond.wind_code AND ts.security_code IS NOT NULL AND ts.security_code != '' AND IFNULL(ts.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND ts.status = 'updated' ) ORDER BY bond.wind_code ASC

SELECT bond.wind_code AS security_code ,bond.short_name AS security_short_name ,bond.security_type ,bond.abs_flag ,bond.issuer_code ,bond.issuer AS issuer_name ,bond.issuer_code AS trigger_company_code FROM rrs_securityinfo bond INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = bond.security_type AND dst.is_deleted = 0 AND dst.category_type = 'bond' INNER JOIN ip_investment_pool p ON p.id = #{poolId} AND IFNULL(p.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE bond.security_status != 'D' AND (bond.maturity_date IS NULL OR bond.maturity_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m%d'))
AND NOT (COALESCE(bond.abs_flag, 0) = 1 OR bond.security_type = 'abs')
AND bond.security_type NOT IN
#{securityType}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status cps INNER JOIN dict_security_type cdst ON cdst.security_type = cps.security_type AND cdst.is_deleted = 0 AND cdst.category_type = 'company' WHERE cps.security_code = bond.issuer_code AND cps.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND cps.audit_status = '20' AND cps.is_deleted = 0 )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status bps WHERE bps.security_code = bond.wind_code AND bps.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND bps.audit_status = '20' AND bps.is_deleted = 0 )
AND ( COALESCE(JSON_LENGTH(p.market_codes), 0) = 0 OR JSON_CONTAINS(p.market_codes, JSON_QUOTE(TRIM(bond.market))) )

SELECT ips.security_code ,MAX(ips.security_short_name) AS security_short_name ,'company' AS security_type FROM ip_pool_status ips WHERE ips.target_pool_id = #{sourcePoolId} AND ips.security_type = 'company' AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status tgt WHERE tgt.security_code = ips.security_code AND tgt.target_pool_id = #{targetPoolId} AND tgt.security_type = 'company' AND tgt.audit_status = '20' AND tgt.is_deleted = 0 ) GROUP BY ips.security_code ORDER BY ips.security_code ASC

WITH rated AS ( SELECT r.s_info_compcode ,r.s_info_compname ,r.b_info_creditrating ,COALESCE(NULLIF(r.ann_dt2, ''), NULLIF(r.ann_dt, ''), '00000000') AS declare_dt ,CASE TRIM(r.b_info_creditrating) WHEN 'AAA+' THEN 21 WHEN 'AAA' THEN 20 WHEN 'AA+' THEN 19 WHEN 'AA' THEN 18 WHEN 'AA-' THEN 17 WHEN 'A+' THEN 16 WHEN 'A' THEN 15 WHEN 'A-' THEN 14 WHEN 'BBB+' THEN 13 WHEN 'BBB' THEN 12 WHEN 'BBB-' THEN 11 WHEN 'BB+' THEN 10 WHEN 'BB' THEN 9 WHEN 'BB-' THEN 8 WHEN 'B+' THEN 7 WHEN 'B' THEN 6 WHEN 'B-' THEN 5 WHEN 'CCC' THEN 4 WHEN 'CC' THEN 3 WHEN 'C' THEN 2 WHEN 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS rating_value FROM ais_inv_ods.wind_cbondissuerrating r WHERE r.s_info_compcode IS NOT NULL AND r.s_info_compcode != '' AND r.b_info_creditrating IS NOT NULL AND r.b_info_creditrating != ''
AND r.b_info_creditratingagency IN
#{agencyCode}
AND 1 = 0
AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.ann_dt2, ''), NULLIF(r.ann_dt, ''), '00000000') >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), '%Y%m%d') )
,effective AS ( SELECT s_info_compcode ,s_info_compname ,b_info_creditrating FROM ( SELECT s_info_compcode ,s_info_compname ,b_info_creditrating ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY s_info_compcode ORDER BY rating_value ASC ,declare_dt DESC ) AS rn FROM rated WHERE rating_value > 0 ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 )
SELECT e.s_info_compcode AS security_code ,COALESCE(NULLIF(e.s_info_compname, ''), e.s_info_compcode) AS security_short_name ,'company' AS security_type ,e.b_info_creditrating AS outer_rating FROM effective e WHERE e.b_info_creditrating IN ( 'AA-', 'A+', 'A', 'A-' ,'BBB+', 'BBB', 'BBB-' ,'BB+', 'BB', 'BB-' ,'B+', 'B', 'B-' ,'CCC', 'CC', 'C' ,'D' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status ips WHERE ips.security_code = e.s_info_compcode AND ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.security_type = 'company' AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 ) ORDER BY e.s_info_compcode ASC

WITH rated AS ( SELECT r.s_info_compcode ,r.s_info_compname ,r.b_info_creditrating ,COALESCE(NULLIF(r.ann_dt2, ''), NULLIF(r.ann_dt, ''), '00000000') AS declare_dt ,CASE TRIM(r.b_info_creditrating) WHEN 'AAA+' THEN 21 WHEN 'AAA' THEN 20 WHEN 'AA+' THEN 19 WHEN 'AA' THEN 18 WHEN 'AA-' THEN 17 WHEN 'A+' THEN 16 WHEN 'A' THEN 15 WHEN 'A-' THEN 14 WHEN 'BBB+' THEN 13 WHEN 'BBB' THEN 12 WHEN 'BBB-' THEN 11 WHEN 'BB+' THEN 10 WHEN 'BB' THEN 9 WHEN 'BB-' THEN 8 WHEN 'B+' THEN 7 WHEN 'B' THEN 6 WHEN 'B-' THEN 5 WHEN 'CCC' THEN 4 WHEN 'CC' THEN 3 WHEN 'C' THEN 2 WHEN 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS rating_value FROM ais_inv_ods.wind_cbondissuerrating r WHERE r.s_info_compcode IS NOT NULL AND r.s_info_compcode != '' AND r.b_info_creditrating IS NOT NULL AND r.b_info_creditrating != ''
AND r.b_info_creditratingagency IN
#{agencyCode}
AND 1 = 0
AND COALESCE(NULLIF(r.ann_dt2, ''), NULLIF(r.ann_dt, ''), '00000000') >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), '%Y%m%d') )
,effective AS ( SELECT s_info_compcode ,s_info_compname ,b_info_creditrating FROM ( SELECT s_info_compcode ,s_info_compname ,b_info_creditrating ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY s_info_compcode ORDER BY rating_value ASC ,declare_dt DESC ) AS rn FROM rated WHERE rating_value > 0 ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 )
SELECT ips.security_code ,COALESCE(NULLIF(e.s_info_compname, ''), NULLIF(ips.security_short_name, ''), ips.security_code) AS security_short_name ,'company' AS security_type ,e.b_info_creditrating AS outer_rating FROM ip_pool_status ips LEFT JOIN effective e ON e.s_info_compcode = ips.security_code WHERE ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.security_type = 'company' AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 AND e.b_info_creditrating IS NOT NULL AND e.b_info_creditrating NOT IN ( 'AA-', 'A+', 'A', 'A-' ,'BBB+', 'BBB', 'BBB-' ,'BB+', 'BB', 'BB-' ,'B+', 'B', 'B-' ,'CCC', 'CC', 'C' ,'D' )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status lim WHERE lim.security_code = ips.security_code AND lim.security_type = 'company' AND lim.audit_status = '20' AND lim.is_deleted = 0 AND lim.target_pool_id IN
#{limitPoolId}
)
ORDER BY ips.security_code ASC
SELECT DISTINCT ips.security_code FROM ip_pool_status ips WHERE ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.security_type = 'company' AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0

SELECT bond.wind_code AS security_code ,bond.short_name AS security_short_name ,bond.security_type ,bond.abs_flag ,bond.issuer_code ,bond.issuer AS issuer_name FROM rrs_securityinfo bond INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = bond.security_type AND dst.is_deleted = 0 AND dst.category_type = 'bond'
WHERE bond.issuer_code = #{companyCode}
AND bond.security_status != 'D'
AND (bond.maturity_date IS NULL OR bond.maturity_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m%d'))
AND NOT (COALESCE(bond.abs_flag, 0) = 1 OR bond.security_type = 'abs')
AND bond.security_type NOT IN
#{securityType}
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status ips WHERE ips.security_code = bond.wind_code AND ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 ) ORDER BY bond.wind_code ASC

SELECT bond.wind_code AS security_code ,bond.short_name AS security_short_name ,bond.security_type ,bond.abs_flag FROM rrs_securityinfo bond INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = bond.security_type AND dst.is_deleted = 0 AND dst.category_type = 'bond' INNER JOIN ip_pool_status ips ON ips.security_code = bond.wind_code AND ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 WHERE (bond.issuer_code = #{companyCode} OR ((COALESCE(bond.abs_flag, 0) = 1 OR bond.security_type = 'abs') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ais_inv_ods.wind_cbondissuer abs_issuer WHERE abs_issuer.s_info_windcode = bond.wind_code AND abs_issuer.s_info_compcode = #{companyCode} AND abs_issuer.s_info_typecode IN (115004000, 115203000, 115200000, 115201000) ))) AND bond.security_status != 'D' AND (bond.maturity_date IS NULL OR bond.maturity_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m%d'))
AND NOT (COALESCE(bond.abs_flag, 0) = 1 OR bond.security_type = 'abs')
AND bond.security_type NOT IN
#{securityType}
ORDER BY bond.wind_code ASC

SELECT ips.security_code ,ips.security_short_name ,ips.security_type ,ips.crmw_name ,ips.crmw_scode ,ips.crmw_mktcode ,ips.crmw_stype ,crmw.maturity_date FROM ip_pool_status_crmw ips INNER JOIN rrs_securityinfo crmw ON crmw.wind_code = ips.crmw_scode WHERE ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 AND ips.pool_type = 'crmw' AND crmw.security_type = 'crmw' AND crmw.maturity_date IS NOT NULL AND crmw.maturity_date != '' AND crmw.maturity_date < DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{maturityOffsetDays} DAY), '%Y%m%d') ORDER BY ips.crmw_scode ASC ,ips.security_code ASC

SELECT bond.wind_code AS security_code ,bond.short_name AS security_short_name ,bond.security_type ,bond.abs_flag ,bond.issuer_code ,bond.issuer AS issuer_name FROM ip_pool_status ips INNER JOIN rrs_securityinfo bond ON bond.wind_code = ips.security_code INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = bond.security_type AND dst.is_deleted = 0 AND dst.category_type = 'bond' WHERE ips.target_pool_id = #{bondPoolId} AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 AND bond.security_status != 'D'
AND NOT (COALESCE(bond.abs_flag, 0) = 1 OR bond.security_type = 'abs')
AND bond.security_type NOT IN
#{securityType}
AND bond.issuer_code IS NOT NULL AND bond.issuer_code != '' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status cps INNER JOIN dict_security_type cdst ON cdst.security_type = cps.security_type AND cdst.is_deleted = 0 AND cdst.category_type = 'company' WHERE bond.issuer_code = cps.security_code AND cps.target_pool_id = #{companyPoolId} AND cps.audit_status = '20' AND cps.is_deleted = 0 ) ORDER BY bond.wind_code ASC
